label_mapping.basis: O'Hara (1968), key to Fig. 4 (printed p. 87), which assigns the labels 1921, PB (after Tilley & Yoder 1964, Tilley et al. 1963) and E1, E2, KA, ML, ML 87, MK, 1955/77, 1955/82, KO, KP, 1840b2 (after Tilley et al. 1963, 1964).
label_mapping.1921: Yoder & Tilley (1962) Table 2 no. 14: Tilley & Yoder (1964), Year Book 63 p. 115 Table 4 col. 2, reproduces that analysis for the 1921 olivine tholeiite
label_mapping.ML 87: Yoder & Tilley (1962) Table 2 no. 5 (Mauna Loa 1887): Tilley et al. (1963) footnote 3 lists Y&T Table 2 analyses 3, 5, 7, 7a, 14, 16 as the Hawaiian rocks studied
label_mapping.KP: Yoder & Tilley (1962) Table 2 no. 7 (prehistoric Kilauea), by the same footnote; not found plotted in the digitised figures
label_mapping.1840b2: Year Book 62 Table 3 col. 3: Year Book 63 p. 115 names col. 2 as 1840b1, and cols 2-3 are the only upper-vent 1840 lavas; not found plotted in the digitised figures
label_mapping.PB, KA, MK, ML, E1, E2: labelled directly in the source tables

not_available.1955/77, 1955/82: Tilley (1960), Geological Magazine - not openly accessible
not_available.KO: Wentworth & Winchell (1947) per Tilley et al. (1963), who call Ko the Koolau basalt, whereas O'Hara's key calls KO a Kilauea olivine basalt: ambiguous, and not openly accessible
not_available.AL', OB', P', II, III, IV, OT', QT, BA,: Green & Ringwood (1966, 1967a), Green et al. (1967): behind publisher paywalls
not_available.AV, IK, NM5': Ito & Kennedy (1967), Cohen et al. (1967): not accessible
not_available.A3, 50, 75 and the nodules and models of: O'Hara & Yoder (1967), O'Hara & Mercy (1963), Nixon et al. (1963), Holmes (1936), pyrolite papers: not accessible
